entityName: Člověk v tísni, o.p.s. (People in Need)
entityDescription:
People in Need organization was established in 1992 by a group of Czech war correspondents who were no longer satisfied with merely relaying information about ongoing conflicts and began sending out aid. It gradually became established as a professional humanitarian organization striving to provide aid in troubled regions and support adherence to human rights around the world.
Throughout the 30 years of its existence, People in Need has become one of the biggest non-profit organizations in Central Europe. In addition to humanitarian aid and human rights, it now also targets education and helps people living in social exclusion.
We are part of Alliance2015, a strategic network of seven European non-governmental organizations engaged in humanitarian aid and development projects. This collaboration increases effectiveness, both in working in the target countries and in campaigns aimed at influencing the attitudes of politicians and the general public in Europe.

entityDescription:
AKTI Project and Research Centre was established in Nicosia, Cyprus in 2000 by a group of experts in environment and sustainability. Over the past 24 years, AKTI has become one of the most active environmental NGOs on the island of Cyprus, creating an extensive network of collaborators and volunteers in over 50 countries across Europe and the world.
AKTI promotes and supports the development of a sustainable, equal, just, and inclusive society, with respect towards human rights and the environment. The organization’s main objectives include raising awareness regarding the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals and the European Green Deal for climate mitigation and environmental sustainability, promoting environmental awareness and protection, providing answers and tangible solutions to key environmental challenges, supporting the development of a knowledge-based society, promoting sustainable development through scientific and technological progress, and fostering social inclusion and gender equality. 
AKTI organizes awareness-raising campaigns, knowledge-transfer activities and stakeholder engagement activities, and decision-support policy workshops, whereas dissemination and communication are key-components of the organization’s efforts to ensure maximum impact. AKTI has extensive experience in working with various demographic groups, including urban and rural communities across Cyprus; children, youth, and adults from all walks of life, including policymakers, public authorities, grassroots organisations, CSOs and NGOs, minority groups (e.g., migrant groups, people with disabilities).

entityDescription:
Little Place Labs strive to become the leader in the relatively new satellite edge computing sector. We create sustainable and scalable advanced software and edge computing capabilities for satellites, with the ultimate mission of exploring, protecting our environment, and improving humanity with our Space-based solutions.
Our core products are special machine learning models that can be deployed and run on remote sensing satellites. Raw imagery and other data would be processed to generate usable insights while in orbit, instead of needing to first download massive amounts of raw data to the ground. This not only saves resources and money but enables near real-time insights for quick responses.
Our technology will help to accelerate and improve the identification and analysis of time-sensitive events (such as forest fires, floods, oil spills, logistics, defense, etc) and optimize the efficiency of the delivery of intelligence to decision-makers on the ground. Our wide range of potential customers includes satellite operators, and end-users like governments, local authorities, emergency responders, traders, and insurance companies.

These assets provide unique opportunities to enrich student experience, enhance graduate employability and integrate intellectual input to support business innovation throughout the organisation and beyond. description: boltzplatz is an engineering service provider and a spin-off from the University of Stuttgart (Germany), offering numerical simulations of rarefied gas and plasma dynamics. At the heart of the company lies the open-source software PICLas, which was originally developed to simulate space systems, including atmospheric entry and in-space propulsion. Thanks to a successful technology transfer, companies in the semiconductor manufacturing and vacuum coating industries developing vacuum and plasma technologies can leverage our numerical simulations. This reduces the need for costly prototypes and extensive testing, saving both time and expenses. Potential applications include the prediction of the performance of vacuum pumps, determination of the gas and plasma distribution in vacuum coating equipment, and the characterization of electron and ion beam properties. Beyond complete simulation projects, boltzplatz offers technical support and software development for PICLas.
entityDescription: boltzplatz is a spin-off from the University of Stuttgart and uses the latest scientific findings in simulation technology to solve problems in high-tech industries such as semiconductor manufacturing and vacuum coating. With the help of numerical plasma simulations boltzplatz supports companies in optimizing their products and services. Companies that develop and use vacuum and plasma technologies benefit from the consulting service by reducing the number of expensive prototypes and test series. In addition to detailed insights into the physical processes, costs and time are saved. Their open-source software PICLas allows the treatment of rarefied gas and plasma flows under the influence of electromagnetic fields. With their roots in aerospace, boltzplatz offers simulation projects with a focus on re-entry maneuvers, electric and in-space propulsion.

Imendo is an experienced IT partner with four business divisions and was recently named "Austria's Leading Company" by PwC, Die Presse and the Kreditschutzverband (1st place in Austria in the category of turnover up to EUR 10 million). This is the most important business award in Austria - we were not only recognized for our innovative solutions, but also for our many years of stable growth and excellent company figures. The 4 business areas are

-Enterprise Content Management & Intranet solutions based on Microsoft SharePoint, PowerPlatform and Teams (M365 Collaboration & Communication)
-Customized software development and software integration
-Data analytics & reporting solutions and data warehouse projects
-Cyber Security

More than 90 experienced software engineers, project managers, infrastructure experts and business consultants ensure that your projects are delivered on-budget, on-time and in-quality - but above all that you receive solutions that really support you and your company. Imendo competencies that form the basis of a successful project:

-Customizing close to the standard:
In particular in SharePoint Online-based projects we implement and customize close to Microsoft standards. In this way, we ensure that your SharePoint Online-based ECM solution can continue to be operated on the latest SharePoint configuration even after Microsoft updates.
-Functionality and design:
Imendo's software engineering is characterized by a flexible architecture tailored to the use case and optimal functionality paired with user-friendly interfaces.-Customer needs have priorityWhere individual solutions are necessary, these are adapted to the customer's processes and requirements. Processes are redesigned in consultation with the customer at those points where efficiency/throughput time or usability are required. Extensions can be made as required. Imendo ensures optimal adaptation to your business requirements with great foresight.
Multi-device / flexible use:
Cross-platform development is used to create applications that can be used on a wide variety of devices. Depending on specific requirements, the advantages of the different end devices are also used to create an appealing user experience (example: production / warehouse management vs. back office)
-Scaled, cloud-capable infrastructure:
The setup, configuration and customization of infrastructure components - especially for individual extensions - is implemented by Imendo according to the principles of the Microsoft Well-Architected Framework. Preference is given to the implementation of infrastructure components and the operation of applications based on the Azure Cloud Stack. The implementation of applications on the .NET platform enables the development of backend and web applications that can be integrated into almost all server infrastructures. Delivery and hosting can also take place in the form of Docker containers after customer coordination in order to enable hosting independently of the infrastructure or in a hybrid setup (on-premise in the data center, Azure Cloud or AWS).

entityDescription:
WWT was established in 1946 by the pioneering conservationist Sir Peter Scott, the son of Antarctic explorer Captain Scott. Peter Scott pioneered the idea that taking action to save wetlands and their wildlife involves both inspiring people to care about wetlands and undertaking direct conservation. He set up WWT at Slimbridge, Gloucestershire, as a centre for science and conservation. Uniquely at the time, he opened it to the public so that everyone could enjoy getting close to nature.
WWT is now one of the largest and most respected wetland conservation organisations in the world. We welcome over a million visitors every year to our ten wetland centres and reserves across the UK and we have global reach for our projects to protect wetlands for the people and wildlife that rely on them. In recognition of our expertise in promoting sustainable development through wetland conservation, WWT has been endorsed as one of only six International Organisation Partners by the 170 countries that are signatories to the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands.
We are pioneers in saving threatened wetland wildlife, world experts in wetland management and creation, and a centre for excellence in conservation science.

entityDescription: Terra Quantum Group is a leading quantum technology company. We provide "Quantum as a Service (QaaS)" in three core areas, the first one being "Quantum Algorithms as a Service". Here, customers are provided access to an extensive library of algorithms, such as hybrid quantum optimisation and hybrid quantum neural networks, which can be used for solving complex logistics problems or pattern recognition, among other things. Terra Quantum also develops new quantum algorithms for its customers or adapts existing algorithms to their specific needs. Secondly, through "Quantum Computing as a Service", Terra Quantum offers its customers access to its proprietary high-performance simulated quantum processing units (QPU), the quantum ecosystem's physical QPUs, while also developing native QPUs. The third division is "Quantum Security as a Service," through which Terra Quantum offers its unique solutions for secure quantum and post quantum communications worldwide.

entityDescription:
ACCA software is one of the world’s leading producers of software and services for the architecture, engineering and construction industries.A unique company providing the international markets with cutting-edge software solutions adressing all aspects of construction design, execution and maintenance.
Customers can find innovative answers to their needs; from architectural design, structural engineering, analysis and calculations, energy performance analysis, quantity surveying through to construction site health and safety, maintenance and BIM process management.
ACCA is a buildingSMART Multinational Member: all of ACCA’s BIM software are IFC certified by buildingSMART International to ensure the correct use of data in an openBIM® process.
The organisation acknowledges ACCA’s key role in buildingSMART’s technical developments by entering the bSI Awards programme with several projects for which ACCA was finalist in 2021 (with the usBIM.ids project) and also with other award-winning projects in 2020, with usIFC.server, and in 2019, with the Structural E-Permit project.
ACCA is also well known for its BIM collaboration platform equipped with all the major tools and features to manage the BIM process (including clash detection, code checking, IFC editing, etc.) supporting all openBIM® formats (IFC, BCF, etc.).
ACCA’s Common Data Environment also features a bSI-certified IFC viewer.
